baseline.interpretation: The cohort is evidence about the unchanged policy cells, not Deadline Edge. Private single-round seller finished 0-for-8 while every sampled complete-information game reached agreement.

strict_gain_change.old_action: Offer exactly at the expected-payoff-maximizing latent valuation breakpoint.
strict_gain_change.new_action: Retain 99% of the chosen utility and leave the marginal compatible receiver a strict-positive 1% buffer.

archive_evidence.mechanism: At an exact grid breakpoint the marginal compatible opponent earns zero. The buffer makes that same latent configuration strictly profitable while reducing Granola's conditional payoff by one percent.

private_uncapped.scope: Private uncapped decisions after ten consecutive non-profitable incoming offers.
private_uncapped.action: Walk away rather than occupy a worker until the platform safety cap.

public_uncapped.scope: Complete-information uncapped decisions after ten consecutive positive, non-improving incoming offers.
public_uncapped.action: Accept the positive offer rather than repeat a rejected 55/45 counter until the platform safety cap.

extended_checkpoint.interpretation: The run was stopped at its adverse checkpoint. The public-stall addition did not activate; the losing slice used otherwise unchanged private capped behavior and all five terminal incoming offers were below Granola's reservation value.

fairness_exception.scope: Complete-information terminal offer against the disclosed opponent name 'punish'.
fairness_exception.action: Demand 50% rather than 99% of known surplus.
fairness_exception.evidence: Deadline Edge was accepted in seven of eight resolved games. The sole rejection was punish, which had previously completed a public uncapped agreement at Granola's 45% share.
fairness_exception.unchanged_opponents: Every other disclosed or hidden opponent retains the 99% terminal demand.

rollback_if: any invalid move or strategy error
private single-round positive-utility seller acceptance materially underperforms the 25.21% archive baseline
configuration-stratified rating or payoff evidence rejects the one-percent buffer's break-even threshold
